easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Evil Twin.
description:
Cast Evil Twin by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel
When Evil Twin enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Evil Twin. Choose to have Evil Twin enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.
